sloka: तेन बद्धस्ततो ऽस्त्रेण राक्षसेन स वानरः ।अभवन्निर्विचेष्टश्च पपात च महीतले ।। ५.४८.३९।।।।
transliteration: tena baddhastato 'streṇa rākṣasena sa vānaraḥ ।abhavannirviceṣṭaśca papāta ca mahītale ।। 5.48.39।।।।

translations.english: The monkey leader realised that his speed was arrested by the power of the lord Brahma, by the strength of the bond of Brahmastram. He then recalled lord Brahma's boon to him.
